resources.string: Clone cards, write blank tags, and switch smartdoor or payment profiles
Turn on NFC to emulate, scan, or write cards
Scan a smartdoor card, add a manual UID/FeliCa IDm, import .nfc/.mct, or add your payment wallet.
Hold an NFC card to the back of the phone
Phone emulation ready (UID + ATQA + SAK). Works on UID-based smartdoors.
Type-4A / NDEF HCE ready. Emulates directly on phone or writes to NTAG.
FeliCa IDm + PMm + System Code emulation ready.
Encrypted MIFARE Classic sectors detected. UID-only emulation may work on UID doors; for sector-checked doors, use the Write tab with a Gen2/CUID, Gen3, or Gen4 Magic card.
Prepaid / EMV purse keys cannot leave card silicon. Balance inspected read-only; UID-only door clone supported.
Phone emulates 7-byte UID only; use the Write tab to clone full memory onto a physical NTAG tag.
ISO 15693 (NFC-V) cannot be emulated by phone NFCC; full physical block cloning is supported in the Write tab.
Write UID, dumps, or NDEF onto physical Gen2/CUID, Gen3 APDU, Gen4 Ultimate Magic, NTAG/Ultralight, NFC-V, or FeliCa Lite-S tags with automatic anti-brick guards.
Save or scan a non-payment card first to write it onto a physical tag.
Waiting for target tag… (Tap to cancel)
